Oneliner

Flight testing of a satellite communication device for transmitting data from monitoring objects to a ground terminal, including the possibility of relaying through other spacecraft.
Description

The satellite of the Tomsk State University of Control Systems and Radioelectronics was created on the basis of the Geoscan 3U satellite platform.

Designed for flight testing of a satellite communication device for transmitting data from monitoring objects to a ground terminal, including the possibility of relaying through other spacecraft, as well as conducting educational activities within the framework of the Space-π project.

The payload of the device includes:

  • Transceiver module to provide an intersatellite communication channel with the RTU MIREA1 spacecraft ;
  • GNSS receiver in the frequency range L1 (GPS, GLONASS), E1 Galileo;
  • Camera module: angle of view (FOV): 66 degrees, resolution 2 MP.
